purpose: A mobile-first real-time 3D live-dealer studio for Dragon Tiger with a continuous cinematic entrance, readable card dealing, deterministic voice/lipsync, and reusable dealer/table systems.
runtimeSurface: WebGL2 browser runtime with HTML betting overlay; portrait-first 390x844 reference viewport and landscape/desktop adaptations.

hero.role: The dealer's face, hands, shoe, moving card and two landing cards form one uninterrupted readable hero composition.

exceptions: The functional card shoe is camera-left.
The discard tray is camera-right to balance operations without implying a second shoe.
Dealer hand motion is asymmetrical during each card extraction.

circulation.description: A 3.0 m clear central arrival portal leads through a 4.0 m entry corridor to the table. The cinematic camera follows this route and settles into the production gameplay camera. Player navigation ends before the table collision boundary.

environment.source: Blender procedural shell with generated decorative props
